durable_clips.spoken_text: We start at one and add two.
Five tickets make two pairs, with one left over.
Odd numbers have one left over when we make pairs.
Our example is finished. Let's start at one.
We'll count all the way to two hundred ninety-nine.
Nine tickets make four pairs, with one left over.
From ninety-nine, adding two takes us to one hundred one.
We counted by twos, all the way to two hundred ninety-nine!
